default.notes: A visa is required — apply online through the official Lesotho eVisa portal (evisalesotho.com) before travel; applications through a Lesotho mission are also possible where one exists.

groups.notes: SADC citizens enter Lesotho visa-free — typically admitted for up to 30 days per entry; confirm the period stamped at the border.

Visa-free entry — Lesotho waives visas for most Commonwealth, Western European and other partner states, generally for up to 90 days; some nationalities are admitted for shorter periods, so confirm the stay granted at the border.

LS.notes: Home country — no entry requirements for Basotho citizens.
